title: Search engine optimization (SEO)
subtitle: How your store appears in Google and when its link is shared on Facebook and WhatsApp
meta_title_ph: e.g. Elegance Store — women's fashion delivered to every wilaya
meta_description_ph: Two sentences on what you sell and why customers should buy from you…
og_image_hint: Shown when the link is shared. Best size 1200×630. Empty = hero image or logo.
google_verification_hint: Paste the <meta name="google-site-verification" …> tag or just the code.
bing_verification_hint: Paste the <meta name="msvalidate.01" …> tag or just the code.
allow_indexing: Allow search engines to index the store
allow_indexing_hint: Turn off temporarily while the store is being prepared.
